components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Clipped survey-blue action for recording or advancing work.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--survey-deep); background: var(--survey-deep); color: white; font: 650 1rem Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 8px) 0, 100% 8px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); box-shadow: 3px 5px 12px rgb(22 75 108 / 18%); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0f3c59; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--survey) 65%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button-primary { background: #b9e1f3; border-color: #b9e1f3; color: #092236; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: white; } }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action retaining the clipped fieldbook outline.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 650 1rem Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 8px) 0, 100% 8px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-button-quiet:hover { background: white; border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--survey) 65%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Record Field
components.description: Square strong-rule field for household record data.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 700 .75rem Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { color: var(--ink); } .ds-field b { color: var(--utility); } .ds-field input { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--ink); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mylar) 80%, white); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 0; font: 400 1rem Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--survey); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--survey) 65%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ledger Tabs
components.description: Scrollable rule-separated ledger index with ink reversal for the current page.
components.css: .ds-ledger-tabs { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); } .ds-ledger-tabs button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 17px; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mylar-deep) 65%, transparent); color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 1rem Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ledger-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: white; } .ds-ledger-tabs button[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--mylar); } .ds-ledger-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--survey) 65%, white); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Ledger Sheet
components.description: Ruled working sheet for a domain's current records.
components.html:
Service ledger

Current ledger
12 entries

Property records continue below this ruled heading.
components.css: .ds-ledger { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mylar) 94%, white); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); box-shadow: var(--paper-shadow); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 13px) 0, 100% 13px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); font-family: Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger header { min-height: 82px; padding: 17px 21px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); } .ds-ledger h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 1.42rem "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; } .ds-ledger header span { color: var(--survey-deep); font: 700 .66rem "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ledger small { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-ledger p { margin: 0; padding: 17px 21px; color: var(--ink-muted); }

components.name: Site Legend Entry
components.description: Coordinate-led desktop navigation entry with clipped active state.
components.css: .ds-site-entry { min-height: 47px; padding: 0 10px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 37px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #c7d2d2; background: #172a3b; border: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; font-family: Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-site-entry > span { color: #82a2ae; font: 400 .62rem "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-site-entry:hover { color: white; background: #203b50; } .ds-site-entry.active { color: white; background: #203b50; border-color: #456478; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 96% 0, 100% 20%, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-site-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--survey) 65%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: Text-backed semantic state with a compact rectangular color mark.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font-family: Aptos, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-status::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--survey); } .ds-status-complete::before { background: var(--garden); } .ds-status-open::before { background: var(--utility); } .ds-status-cancelled::before { background: var(--ink-muted); }

narrative.overview:
Hearth-v2 treats the household as a mapped working record. Pale drafting mylar, blueprint ink, survey structure, folio coordinates, clipped sheets, and ruled ledgers make the interface feel precise and physical without becoming nostalgic or decorative.

Current work occupies the open field while navigation, evidence, and capture tools stay at the perimeter. Density is compact but legible: strong headings orient, one-pixel rules organize, and semantic color marks attention or truth rather than decorating containers.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled fieldbook surfaces rather than a card grid
Survey-blue structure with sparse utility-orange and garden-green meaning
Square controls and clipped upper-right corners
Fixed desktop legend; sticky mast and bottom index on phones
Light drafting-mylar and dark blueprint-ink themes selected by the operating system

rules.name: The Semantic Mark Rule
rules.body: Survey blue structures; utility orange demands attention; garden green confirms truth. Pair every color mark with text, position, or shape.

rules.name: The Mylar Reversal Rule
rules.body: Theme changes reverse the material from pale mylar to blueprint ink without changing hierarchy or meaning.

rules.name: The Coordinate Reserve Rule
rules.body: Monospace belongs to coordinates and machine-like metadata, never ordinary prose or major headings.

rules.name: The Ruled Before Raised Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with ink, tonal layers, and one-pixel boundaries before adding a shadow.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: Clip only the upper-right corner; do not mix radii, pills, or multiple ornamental cuts into the fieldbook silhouette.

dos: Do use one-pixel rules and tonal layering as the default structure.
Do keep folio coordinates functional and pair semantic color with readable status text.
Do preserve the fixed-legend-to-bottom-index responsive transformation.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences; loading survey motion collapses to effectively static.
donts: Don't turn records into a generic floating-card grid.
Don't use pills, soft rounded cards, gradients as decoration, or ornamental corner variation.
Don't use utility orange or garden green as broad surface fills when a compact mark communicates the state.
Don't use monospace for ordinary body copy or Barlow Condensed for form controls.
